_comment: THE RECORD-ONLY ADVANCE PARITY CORPUS (PLAN-ciquick-gate-contract R1). One case list, one expected verdict per case,
driven against both halves of the decision: scripts/ci-runner/run.ts planAdvance (its --selftest) and
(.claude/rediacc_hooks/tests/test_unverified_push_advance_parity.py). A change to either half that the other does not
make fails one of them. The token <carried-reds> stands for the carry file path (CARRIED_REL on both sides). `policy` is the record policy document (null: the tree has none), `paths` the diff
(null: git cannot list it), `known` the manifest ids, `entries` each tree's ls-tree rows [mode, type, oid, path],
`carried` each tree's carry file (a document, or raw text). `expect` is {kind: full, code} or

cases.name: a review-only commit advances through its reader alone
THE 2026-11-28 INCIDENT: a carried verdict whose inputs moved only through a record path is re-run alone, not the lane
the same carried verdict listed as failed runs the lane under the red rule
CONTROL: one code path runs the whole lane
an except glob takes a path out of the record set
`?` in a record glob does not cross a slash
`?` in a record glob matches one character
a path two records cover takes the readers of both
a narrowed receipt runs the lane
a receipt of another schema runs the lane
a receipt naming no tree runs the lane
an explicit null failed list is a damaged receipt
a red receipt with no failed gate runs the lane
an unreadable HEAD tree runs the lane
a receipt already naming HEAD is not advanced
a tree with no record policy runs the lane
a diff git cannot list runs the lane
a policy naming a reader outside the manifest runs the lane
a red reader of a touched record runs the lane
a red receipt advances past a record its red does not read
a second advance starts where the chain ends
a carried lists entry whose listing moved is refreshed
CONTROL: a carried lists entry over an unlisted directory is not
a carried refs entry is refreshed on every step
a carry-file step touching another path runs the lane
